description: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.
TRUE: Two teenagers are gaming. One blames the controller, bro.
FALSE: Two teenagers are sleeping. One blames the controller, bro.

description: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.
TRUE: He is giving his heart to an empty theatre! Nobody came!
FALSE: He is giving his heart to an empty stadium! Nobody came!

description: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.
TRUE: She is smelling the flowers. The bee is not happy about it.
FALSE: She is smelling the flowers. The cat is not happy about it.

description: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.
TRUE: She is smiling like a model. He thinks he is a pro.
FALSE: She is frowning like a model. He thinks he is a pro.

description: In a cartoon mountain cabin, a man sits at a table holding his aching head. His friend hands him a small white pill and pours a glass of water; he swallows the pill, drinks, and soon smiles feeling better.
TRUE: One little pill, and he is a new man!
FALSE: One little cookie, and he is a new man!

description: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".
TRUE: Too much powder! A whole cloud, and she blames the brush.
FALSE: Too much glitter! A whole cloud, and she blames the brush.

description: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.
TRUE: So athletic, bro. She thinks she surfs better than any man.
FALSE: So athletic, bro. She thinks she skis better than any man.

description: A retro-cartoon man in a green tracksuit drops strawberries, a banana and milk into a blender, blends it into a pink smoothie, opens the lid and gets a blob of smoothie on his nose, tastes it, then pours the drink into a glass and gives a thumbs up.
TRUE: Cheap blender! Now there is smoothie on his nose!
FALSE: Cheap toaster! Now there is smoothie on his nose!

description: In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.
transcript: Wow, that's tight! Aha! Dead center!
TRUE: You hit the bullseye with your bow. He carries the arrows.
FALSE: You missed the target with your bow. He carries the arrows.

description: A charcoal sketch. A young man in a long robe and a checked headscarf strides forward across desert ground with his gloved arm thrown up and out. A falcon is lifting off his glove, wings fully open, its leash swinging loose from his hand. A pickup truck waits on the sand behind him.
TRUE: He is releasing the falcon. The truck is only the backup.
FALSE: He is releasing the pigeon. The truck is only the backup.

description: An animated woman waits happily at a candlelit rooftop dinner table with spaghetti and a wrapped gift, waving as her partner arrives. He apologetically tells her he cannot stay and leaves, and she is left crying alone at the table, staring sadly at the untouched dinner and present.
transcript: *Door opens* Baralla, I can't stay. But...tonight? I'm sorry. Really. Oh.
TRUE: He is leaving. How disappointing! Who will eat the pasta?
FALSE: He is leaving. How disappointing! Who will eat the pizza?

description: In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.
TRUE: She keeps slipping, but she overcomes her fear!
FALSE: She keeps slipping, so she gives up and goes home!

description: A freediver in a black wetsuit and long carbon fins hangs head-down far below the surface of deep blue open water, sliding down beside a pale guide rope that runs from the sunlit surface into the dark water below him. Small bubbles trail up from his mask towards the light above.
TRUE: He is diving down a rope to a depth where fish look worried.
FALSE: He is rising from a depth where fish look worried.

description: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.
TRUE: Twenty skydivers, one ring formation, zero late arrivals.
FALSE: Five skydivers, one ring formation, zero late arrivals.

description: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.
TRUE: He is looking at the crops as if he grew them all himself.
FALSE: He is looking at the city as if he built it all himself.

description: An anime-style young woman with long auburn hair wears an orange dress covered in a white floral print, standing before a wall of large orange and white flowers with butterflies around her.
TRUE: Bro, her floral dress matches the wall. She's invisible.
FALSE: Bro, her striped dress matches the wall. She's invisible.

description: A dark silhouette of a person balancing upside down on both hands in shallow water, legs split high in the air, with drops splashing up and ripples spreading around the hands, against a plain orange background.
TRUE: Doing a handstand in the water? Don't try this at home, bro.
FALSE: Doing a handstand in the snow? Don't try this at home, bro.
